---
name: requirement-analysis
description: Analyze GitHub issues and business requirements; use before planning a feature or bug fix to establish testable acceptance criteria.
---

# Requirement analysis

1. Read the issue text and relevant existing behavior; distinguish requested changes from assumptions.
2. Identify actors, inputs, outputs, business rules, constraints and non-goals.
3. Assign requirement IDs (R1, R2, ...) and write observable acceptance criteria, including relevant failure cases.
4. Flag contradictions, missing decisions and material ambiguities. Stop for blocking questions; label nonblocking assumptions.
5. Return requirement IDs, acceptance criteria, non-goals, assumptions and blockers to the coordinator. Do not implement changes.
